description: Add a person to a portal group by email. An account in the portal is created when there is none. The new account gets a password of its own, which only the invitation letter shows (with a one-time link that signs the person in); the answer's `invitation` says what was mailed. Never tell anyone a password. move_from_other_groups (default false) moves them out of the portal's other groups.

move_from_other_groups.description: Видалити з усіх інших груп цього порталу (default false)

send_email.description: Mail the portal's invitation letter to a NEW account (default true). false: nobody is told a password — the person sets their own from the portal's sign-in page.

name: add_user_to_portal_group
